chapters.label: The run
chapters.text: Mexico, 1970. England lead West Germany two-nil. The ball bounces loose. Franz Beckenbauer takes it and runs, head up, on and on, past a defender, and scores!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He wins the loose ball and lifts his head: open grass ahead! So he carries it into midfield.

chapters.label: The shot
chapters.text: A low shot with his right foot, under the diving keeper, into the far corner!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Germany won three–two! Win the ball, lift your head, and if there’s space, carry it into midfield, like the Kaiser, Franz Beckenbauer.
